description:
First started it’s to enter Aramco's Discover program across the Saudi Arabia, and through self-education and developing my skills in 3D design, I was able to join the Innovation Center led by the International Technical College for Aviation Sciences, and this opened the way for me to participate in many projects and events.

I had the luck to be part of the rebuilding team of Prince Sultan bin Salman’s Learjet 23, this opportunity I developed skills in the field of aircraft engineering.
